label: Entry storage
description: What the domain needs from entry storage. Bound by monitor-rest.binding.json; a test double binds the same contract.

get.description: One entry by id. Fails when there is no such entry.

record.description: Store a new entry and answer it with its id.

update.description: Replace the call of one entry. Fails when there is no such entry.

remove.description: Delete one entry and answer what was deleted. Fails when there is no such entry.

removeMany.description: Delete several entries at once and answer what was deleted, in the order asked. Fails when any of them does not exist.

ids.description: the entries to remove, each by id

submit.description: Record an observed call, attributing it to this API rather than the client.

method.description: the method it was called with

list.description: Every entry, narrowed to one method when a method is given.

method.description: narrow to this method; absent for everything

digest.description: Every entry counted and listed as one digest.

parseDrafts.description: The entry drafts a CSV file holds: one per row, columns url and method.

toCsv.description: Entries written as a CSV file, one row each.

import.description: Record every entry a CSV file holds, each attributed like a submitted one, and answer them in file order. Fails on a row that is not an entry.

file.description: the CSV file: a header row, then url,method per line

export.description: Every entry as a CSV file.

prepare.description: Make the storage this profile chose ready to answer, once, before anything is served. Over a store it creates the collections the store declares; over the REST API it reads the collection once, so a tree whose upstream is unreachable refuses to serve rather than answering every route with a fault.
